item.text:
Built **Little Library**. The home page shows your currently reading and finished books. You can add a book with notes, mark it finished, open its detail page, and copy a direct link to share it. Books are saved in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json) and remain there after a server restart.

Run `npm start`, then open `http://localhost:3000`. The API and persistence test passes with `npm test`.
